description: Static assertions for leo-prompt — text-to-CAD prompt generator that forces explicit dimensions + build-order + datum, gates on classification (THUONG->Leo cloud, MAT->helix-cad-bridge local)
test_input: make a standard getleo.ai prompt for a one-handed lateral-raise cable handle wrist support, FDM PETG + TPU grip

assertions.name: classification_gate_first
assertions.check: skill gates on classification first — THUONG/personal allows cloud Leo, MAT/HAN-CHE routes to helix-cad-bridge (no cloud)

assertions.name: mat_routes_to_local
assertions.check: MAT/defense geometry refuses cloud Leo and routes to helix-cad-bridge local

assertions.name: explicit_dimensions_table
assertions.check: prompt forces an explicit parametric DIMENSIONS table (real numbers, not adjectives)
assertions.regex: DIMENSIONS|Tham số|Ký hiệu|Giá trị|dimensions table|số thật

assertions.name: build_order_sequence
assertions.check: TASK described as a build-order feature sequence (base -> op -> fillet -> pattern), not a static description

assertions.name: datum_orientation
assertions.check: prompt specifies a datum: origin + symmetry plane + print orientation

assertions.name: measurable_acceptance
assertions.check: prompt includes measurable acceptance checks (bbox, mass, wall thickness) + negative constraints

assertions.name: spatial_blindness_no_invent
assertions.check: operationalizes LLM Spatial Blindness — AI never invents dimensions, asks or marks [CEO điền]

assertions.name: fdm_print_constraints
assertions.check: bakes FDM printability constraints (wall >=3x nozzle, support minimal, overhang)
